--add-download-form.help: Add a download form to your captive portal.

--advanced-help.help: Show extended help options then exit.

--algorithm.help: Specify algorithm with which to sign cert.

--auth.help: Specify authentication mechanism (hostile and captive portal default: open )(creds default: wpa-eap).

--auth-alg.help: Authentication type (open or shared key). (default: shared)

--author.help: Specify author of resulting portal template module

--beacon-interval.help: Send beacon packets every n Time Units (TUs). A single TU is equal to 1024 microseconds. (default: 100)

--ca-cert.help: Specify path to ca cert file.

--ca-key.help: Specify path to CA private key file.

--captive-portal.help: Force clients to connect to a captive portal

--captive-portal-server-only.help: Run the captive portal server as astandalone service.

--capture-wpa-handshakes.help: Capture 4-way WPA handshakes (wpa-psk default: yes) (wpa-eap and sae defaults: no)

--cert-wizard.help: Use this flag to run in Cert Wizard mode. Use "--cert-wizard create" to create a new certificate. Use "--cert-wizard interactive" or simply "--cert-wizard" to run Cert Wizard in interactive mode. Use "--cert-wizard import" to import a set of certificates into eaphammer's static configuration. Use "--cert-wizard list" to list all previously imported certs, as well as the active cert configuration. Use "--cert-wizard dh" to manually regenerate eaphammer's dh parameters.

--channel-width.help: Set the channel width in MGHz (single 20 MGHz spatial stream or two 20 MGHz spatial streams totalling 40 MGHz). (default: 20)

--cloaking.help: Send empty SSID in beacons and ignore probe request frames that do not specify full SSID (i.e. require stations to know SSID). Choices: [1. none - do not use SSID cloaking. ] [2. full - Send empty string in beacon and ignore probe requests for broadcast SSID ] [3. zeroes - Replace all characters in SSID with ASCII 0 and ignore probe requests for broadcast SSID.]

--cn.help: Specify certificate CN when running --bootstrap or "--cert-wizard create".

--country.help: Specify certificate country when running --bootstrap or "--cert-wizard create".

--create-template.help: Create a template by cloaning a login page

--creds.help: Harvest EAP creds using evil twin attack

--description.help: Specify description of resulting portal template module

--dh-file.help: Manually specify path to dh_file at runtime.

--dl-form-message.default: Please download our secure profile to continue.

--dtim-period.help: Transmit broadcast frames after every n beacons, where n is an integer between 1 and 255. (default: 1)

--eap-spray.help: Check for password reuse by spraying a single password across a series of usernames against target ESSID.

--eap-user-file.help: Manually specify path to eap_user_file (instead of using EAPHammer's accounting system)

--email.help: Specify certificate emailAddress attribute when running --bootstrap or "--cert-wizard create".

--fragm-threshold.help: Sets the fragmentation threshold in octets. (default: 2346)

--hostile-portal.help: Force clients to connect to hostile portal

--ht40.help: Specifies whether the secondary channel should be higher (plus) or lower (minus) than the primary channel. (default: auto)

--hw-mode.help: Specify access point hardware mode (defaults: g for 2.4GHz channels, a for 5GHz channels).

--interface.help: The phy interface on which to create the AP

--interface-pool.help: List of interfaces available for password spray attack.

--known-ssids.help: Specify known ssids via the CLI

--known-ssids-file.help: Specify the wordlist to use with the --known-beacons features.

--list-templates.help: List available templates for the captive portal

--locale.help: Specify certificate locale (city) attribute when running --bootstrap or "--cert-wizard create".

--lport.help: Port on which to run captive portal.

--mac-blacklist.help: Enable MAC address blacklisting and specify path to blacklist file.

--mac-whitelist.help: Enable MAC address whitelisting and specify path to whitelist file.

--manual-config.help: Bypass eaphammer's hostapd configuration manager and load your own hostapd.conf file instead.

--max-num-stations.help: The maximum number of stations that can connect to the AP at any one time. (default: 255)

--max-spatial-streams.help: Specifies maximum number of spatial streams. (default: 2)

--name.help: Specify name of resulting portal template module

--no-wait.help: do not wait for tag to be removed before exiting

--not-after.help: Specify datetime on which cert should become active.

--not-before.help: Specify datetime on which cert should become active.

--obss-interval.help: Look this up if you don't know what it does. You probably don't need it. (default: 0)

--only-one.help: run only one operation and exit

--org.help: Specify certificate organization when running --bootstrap or "--cert-wizard create".

--org-unit.help: Specify certificate org unit when running --bootstrap or "--cert-wizard create".

--password.help: Specify password to be sprayed across list of users.

--payload.help: Specify payload name (defaults to payload.msi test file)

--phase-1-methods.help: Manually specify EAP phase 1 methods for for wildcard user EAP negotiate.

--phase-2-methods.help: Manually specify EAP phase 2 methods for for wildcard user EAP negotiate.

--pivot.help: Runs responder without SMB server enabled.

--pmf.help: Enable, disaable, or require the use of Protected Management Frames (PMF) (802.11w) (default: disable) (OWE default: require).

--pmkid.help: Perform clientless attack against PSK network using ZerBea's hcxtools.

--portal-debug.help: Show debug for portal server only

--private-key.help: Specify path to private key file.

--psk-capture-file.help: Path to which to write WPA handshakefiles (default: automatically generated from nonce and current timestamp)

--remote-cracking-rig.help: Use remote cracking rig for autocrack feature.

--require-ht.help: Reject associations from clients that do not support HT.

--rts-threshold.help: Sets the RTS threshold in octets. (default: 2347)

--save-config.help: Save hostapd config file on exist.

--save-config-only.help: Don't actually run anything. Instead, just generate a hostapd config file using user supplied parameters then exit.

--self-signed.help: Combine with "--cert-wizard create" to create a self-signed cert.

--server-cert.help: Specify path to server cert file. Can be used with "--cert-wizard import" to import a cert or cert chain, or with any attack to override eaphammer's static configuration. File must be in PEM format and may contain full certificate chain and/or private key. If file does not contain private key, the --private-key flag should be used. Likewise, if the file does not contain a CA certificate chain, the --ca-cert flag should be used.

--short-gi.help: Enable short GI (20 or 40 depending on channel width

--ssid-blacklist.help: Enable MAC address blacklisting and specify path to blacklist file.

--ssid-whitelist.help: Enable MAC address whitelisting and specify path to whitelist file.

--state.help: Specify certificate state or province when running --bootstrap or "--cert-wizard create".

--success.help: success file for writing success update

--summary.help: summary file for writing status updates

--troll-defender.help: Trigger Windows Defender on nearby devices by spawning an AP with SSID set to C:\Temp\Invoke-Mimikatz.ps1

--url.help: Specify url from which to clone captive portal

--use-max-a-msdu-length.help: Set A-MSDU length to maximum allowable value (7935 octets). If not set, 3839 octets are used.

--user-list.help: Like a wordlist, except contains usernames instead of passwords. Each username should be placed on a separate line.

--wmm.help: Enable wmm (further configuration of wmm performed in hostapd.ini)

--wordlist.help: Specify the wordlist to use with the autocrack feature.

-K.help: Include key data in debug messages.

-t.help: Include timestamps in some debug messages.
